units.source_text: 终于背后叽叽喳喳，像是大网篮到了。

en.t: At last there was a chattering behind him, as if the large rope basket had arrived.

units.source_text: 三个男人，在鞋底下垫上了板，歪歪倒倒地，开始从远处往他身边挖掘过来。

en.t: Three men, with boards strapped under the soles of their shoes, began staggering and digging toward him from a distance.

units.source_text: 沙子扑扑地一层层坍塌。

en.t: The sand softly collapsed, layer after layer.

units.source_text: 理想、绝望、羞耻、体面都被这些沙子埋葬了，消失了。

en.t: Ideals, despair, shame, and dignity had all been buried by this sand and had disappeared.

units.source_text: 就连男人们的手搭上他的肩膀，他都没哆嗦一下。

en.t: Even when the men's hands came down on his shoulders, he did not flinch at all.

units.source_text: 要是听他们吩咐，脱下裤子的话，众目睽睽之下，也许连大便都会下来吧。

en.t: If they ordered him to take off his trousers, he might even defecate right there under everyone's eyes.

units.source_text: 天空很亮，不久，月亮也会出来吧。

en.t: The sky was bright, and before long the moon would probably come out too.

units.source_text: 女人会是什么表情来迎接呢？

en.t: What kind of expression would the woman have when she greeted him?

units.source_text: ……管她什么样……眼下就是当挨打坯子也会习惯的。

en.t: ... Whatever she looked like ... right now he could even get used to being someone made to take a beating.
